sql: with o as (select market_ticker, event_ticker, min(created_at) first_at, max(created_at) last_at, count(*) n, string_agg(distinct coalesce(cancel_reason,status),',') why from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and action='buy' and created_at > '2026-10-12' group by 1,2), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, start_date, end_date, period_reward_usd, target_size, market_title from incentive_programs where incentive_type='liquidity' and market_ticker in (select market_ticker from o) order by market_ticker, last_seen_at desc) select o.event_ticker, o.market_ticker, to_char(o.first_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') first, to_char(o.last_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') last, o.n, to_char(p.start_date,'MM-DD HH24:MI') pstart, to_char(p.end_date,'MM-DD HH24:MI') pend, p.period_reward_usd rew, o.why from o left join p using (market_ticker) order by p.end_date, 1, 2
